Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You just open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All of the roughly 12,408 games run in your browser and start instantly, with no download and no install.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Often, yes. Many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn your phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site is family-friendly only, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Your recently played games, favourites, light or dark choice and the progress of most games stay on your device and never leave it. If you clear your browser data or play in private mode, they are lost.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If it is a game that needs a keyboard and mouse, the page says so, so check that first. If it still does not work, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. Others are licensed from the networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and 24 were sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?
Yes, it is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and accepted games get their own page that credits you and links back to you.
Can I have my game removed?
Yes, at any time. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you just need to email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
You can embed the games made by Door 404. Each has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they cannot be embedded.
How do I reach a real person?
Email contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
